Six independent exact finite-residue shortest-path computations corroborate examples, not replacing the uniform proof.

value.rationale: Determines complete pole-order geometry at the unique rational point at infinity of newly constructed maximal non-Hermitian-covered curves for all even \(n\ge4\) and prime-power \(q>2\), including exact minimal generators, multiplicity, embedding dimension, conductor and non-symmetry. Completeness and conductor are not provided by Ma–Wang Lemma 4.1, which only lists individual nongaps. These intrinsically motivated invariants control one-point AG-code Riemann–Roch pole spaces; they are not determined by genus alone.
